title: Side Window Web — Delamination Repair at the Aft Lower Corner

ata.title: Flight Compartment Windows — Side Window Assembly

abstract: Repair of delamination in the side window web at the aft lower corner, where moisture behind the seal separates the web laminate, with the dry-out schedule and the resin injection acceptance.

sections.purpose: This repair covers delamination in the side window web at the aft lower corner, found by tap test or ultrasonic inspection after moisture has been detected behind the seal.
sections.damage_assessment: Remove the side window and strip the sealant. Do a tap test over the corner region and confirm any suspect area by ultrasonic inspection, mapping the boundary on the web with a soft pencil. The repair admits a single delaminated area up to 1 200 square millimetres, not extending under the fastener rows and not closer than 15 millimetres to the web edge. Two separate areas, or any delamination that reaches a fastener row, are outside this repair. Record the moisture content of the web with the meter before the dry-out starts, because the acceptance after injection is judged against the initial reading.
sections.repair_procedure: Dry the web with the heat blanket at the schedule on the repair drawing, holding the temperature within the stated band and recording the profile. Do not exceed the maximum temperature: the web resin degrades above it and the repair becomes a web replacement. Drill the injection and vent holes at the positions shown. Inject the resin slowly at ambient temperature until it appears at the vent, then hold the pressure for the stated time. Cure with the blanket at the stated schedule and record the profile. Fill the injection and vent holes and blend the surface flush. Restore the protection scheme, then refit the window with a new seal and the sealant standard applicable to the frame configuration.
sections.inspection_requirements: Do an ultrasonic inspection over the repaired area after cure and record the baseline map. Repeat the ultrasonic inspection at the next window removal and at every 4 000 flight hours. Do a detailed visual inspection of the corner at every A check for moisture staining. A repair that grows by more than 10 per cent in area between inspections must be reported and the window replaced.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: One delaminated area up to 1 200 mm², not extending under a fastener row and not closer than 15 mm to the web edge.

repair_drawings.title: Side window web resin injection repair, aft lower corner

materials.description: WEB, SIDE WINDOW ASSEMBLY, SUB-ASSY, AFT

type_data.fastener_pattern: No new fasteners. Injection and vent holes at the positions on the repair drawing, filled and blended flush after cure.
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Temporary repair valid for 8 000 flight hours or until the next window removal, whichever occurs first. Ultrasonic inspection every 4 000 flight hours.
